reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and I can't judge a paper pendant's build quality from photos. Nothing here gives me lumens, UL listing or install details, and I'm not putting a fixture my electrician has to sign off on into an Airbnb unit on a guess.
objection: I can't tell the quality from photos, and I see no UL listing, lumens or wiring specs. If it arrives flimsy or isn't listed, I eat the return shipping and the 10 to 12 day wait pushes back my winter refresh.
would_change_my_mind: A UL/ETL listing and a full spec sheet (lumens, CRI, wiring and mounting details) on the product page, plus real photos or reviews from other hosts or designers, or a cheap sample I could inspect before ordering for two units.
